commands.cmd:
D=$(mktemp -d); cat > $D/t.py <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Union, Tuple
from typing_extensions import Literal, Final
def f() -> Union[Tuple[str], Tuple[Literal[1]]]:
    return (2,)
PY
python -m mypy --cache-dir=$D/c --strict --python-version 3.7 $D/t.py; echo rc=$?
